description: This is a Java Spring Boot REST controller class named AnswerController. It handles HTTP requests related to answers associated with questions, including fetching, creating, updating, and deleting answers tied to specific question IDs. The class interacts with AnswerRepository and QuestionRepository to perform database operations and enforces validation and exception handling.

classes.name: AnswerController
classes.description: A REST controller for managing Answer entities related to questions. Provides endpoints for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting answers for a given question.

methods.name: getAnswersByQuestionId
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a list of answers associated with a specific question ID.

methods.name: addAnswer
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new answer linked to a specific question ID, validating the input.

methods.name: updateAnswer
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing answer's text for a given answer ID and question ID, with validation and existence checks.

methods.name: deleteAnswer
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove an answer by answer ID associated with a specific question, with proper existence verification.
